title: Armageddon dream with the number 747 and number cubes

tellings.quote: incredibly vivid dream in in the midst of all this at that Fort Knox where I dreamt that I was in a battle like a battle of Armageddon.

plain: In 1976, while posted at Fort Knox, a US Army base in Kentucky, Rolf Mowatt-Larssen had an "incredibly vivid" dream that he was fighting in something like the battle of Armageddon, and the dream featured the number 747 and cubes with numbers on them. Mowatt-Larssen, who later became a senior CIA officer, tells it as his own experience and points to his book A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. He brings it up as an early sign of the strange experiences he went on to have.
